lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the San Miguel County BOCC, which holds public hearings Tuesday on three Land Use Code amendments — including changes to 'Qualified Owner' definitions, a wildfire areas update, and nonconforming lots, all moving toward formal votes. Telluride Town Council follows Monday with third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code, which would rewrite historic review and landscaping standards for property owners across town. Sandwiched in between, the Housing Authority Subcommittee takes up a deed-restricted homeowner's roof replacement request, and the Telluride Jazz Festival opens Friday.
